changeSet.sql: create or alter function [dbo].[AssetWithAssetsByTypeUserCantRead] ( @ResourceID int ) returns table as return ( select AssetID, AssetTypeID from dbo.ResponsibilitySummary where ResourceID = @ResourceID and ApplyToType = 0 and [Permissions] & 1 = 0 union all select A.ID as AssetID, A.AssetTypeID from dbo.ResponsibilitySummary S inner join dbo.Asset A on A.AssetTypeID = S.AssetTypeID and S.ResourceID = @ResourceID and S.ApplyToType = 1 and S.[Permissions] & 1 = 0 union all select A.ID as AssetID, A.AssetTypeID from dbo.Asset A inner join dbo.AssetType T on T.ID = A.AssetTypeID where T.DefaultPermissions = 0 and not exists(select 1 from reporting.Global_Resource where ResourceID = @ResourceID and IsAdministrator = 1) and not exists(select 1 from dbo.ResponsibilitySummary where AssetID = A.ID and ResourceID = @ResourceID) and not exists(select 1 from dbo.ResponsibilitySummary where ApplyToType = 1 and AssetTypeID = T.ID and ResourceID = @ResourceID) )
